items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: He said, I'm going to let you see who Miss Bimford is. And whenever you see her come in that door... We didn't play anything but the sweetest type of foxtrot... Then we finally won her over.

ctx.x: We had Joe, the same boy. See, I didn't change very much. You didn't change? No, no, no. Those boys stayed with me right on through. The clarinet, do you remember? I was playing Clown Insect for myself. Oh, you were playing Clown Insect for yourself. Yeah. And after the second week, he said, well, I'm afraid we're going to have to dismiss you because she's complaining too much. I said, well, that was the agreement, it's all right. Well, we were there just long enough to have won over the young dancers, all of the…
